notes: CORRECTION (2026-10-11, this run): the A3 "failed" status is a driver-bookkeeping artifact, NOT an engine failure. The Grazer ETB trigger fired (observed on the stack, mid_trigger.json) and the driver accepted the "you may"; the engine then auto-resolved the forced land choice (P0 had exactly 1 Forest in hand) and put Forest oid 57 from Hand onto the Battlefield tapped (verified in pre/post states). No land-target interaction was offered by the engine, so OBS["land_put_oid"] stayed None and the coded A3 check failed. The v0.105.0 run offered a schema/select land choice because P0 held 5 Forests there; the auto-resolve with a single candidate is the same correct outcome. The reported headline bug ("Zenith does not trigger ETB") does NOT reproduce on v0.106.0.
